metadata.title: Team Main Bhi Bharat in Odisha
metadata.description:
Odisha has 62, yes 62, different tribal groups. Out of these 13 have been classified as PVTG or Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups. 

Our team is currently travelling in Balasore district of the state, meeting the tribals there, hearing and documenting their stories to bring it to you. Here's a tiny glimpse of the delights that are in store for you on our channel. 

In case you have some catching up to do, please watch our previous videos from Gujarat Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh

#Adivasi_Bharat #Odisha #Tribal_Culture
